pages.quiz:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. German for “school” is: (1 mark)
   A. Wasser
   B. Schule
   C. Buch
   D. Haus

2. When practising Reading Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Comprehension.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading Comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading Comprehension.

3. When practising Reading Aloud, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading Aloud.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Aloud.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Aloud.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading Aloud.

4. When practising Imitative speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Imitative speaking.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Imitative speaking.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Imitative speaking.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Imitative speaking.

5. When practising Reading aloud, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading aloud.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading aloud.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading aloud.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading aloud.

6. When practising Listening for gist, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for gist.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for gist.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening for gist.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening for gist.

7. When practising Phonological awareness , Imitative speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Phonological awareness , Imitative speaking.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological awareness , Imitative speaking.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Phonological awareness , Imitative speaking.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological awareness , Imitative speaking.

8. When practising Guided writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Guided writing.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Guided writing.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided writing.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Guided writing.

9. “Guten Tag” means: (1 mark)
   A. Please
   B. Thank you
   C. Good night
   D. Good day / hello

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Reading Aloud and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Reading aloud and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Reading Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Guided writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Schule

2. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Comprehension.

3. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Aloud.

4. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Imitative speaking.

5. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading aloud.

6. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for gist.

7. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological awareness , Imitative speaking.

8. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided writing.

9. D — Good day / hello

10. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Reading Aloud; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

11. (4 marks)

12. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Reading Comprehension; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Guided writing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
